mechanism_narrative: A higher CPIAUCSL (current value 243.846) indicates persistent inflation, which leads to reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 20d S&P 500 returns is not negative (i.e., Rank IC >= -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the FEDFUNDS above 2.0% (current value 0.91) indicates a tightening monetary policy, which leads to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 5d S&P 500 returns is not negative (i.e., Rank IC >= -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL is above 240.0 and FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, it indicates a 'stagflation' scenario (high inflation without monetary easing), which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the interaction condition (CPIAUCSL>240.0 AND FEDFUNDS<1.0%) and 60d S&P 500 returns is not negative (i.e., Rank IC >= -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 240.0), a FEDFUNDS level below 0.5% signals a monetary policy easing, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS (when CPIAUCSL>240.0) and 20d S&P 500 returns is not positive (i.e., Rank IC <= 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher HOUST (current value 1172.0) indicates strong demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between HOUST and 60d S&P 500 returns is not positive (i.e., Rank IC <= 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below 100.0 (current value 105.0284) indicates a contraction in industrial output, which signals an impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO and 5d S&P 500 returns is not negative (i.e., Rank IC >= -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 5.0% (current value 4.3) indicates a tight labor market, which is associated with rising wage pressures and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between UNRATE and 60d S&P 500 returns is not negative (i.e., Rank IC >= -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE is below 4.0% and FEDFUNDS is above 2.0%, it indicates a tight labor market combined with restrictive monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
